title: Business Analyst system description
description: The typed contract the Business Analyst agent emits from a parsed Visio diagram and hands to the Architect agent. A plain-language description of the system with a candidate ArchiMate classification per element; the Architect validates and formalises it. Grouping (actors/components/data/behaviors) is a BA organising aid; layer+aspect+candidateType is what the Architect consumes.

systemName.description: Short name of the system the diagram depicts.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the system is and does, in plain language.

actors.description: Who or what acts on the system: people, roles, external systems (business/active structure).

components.description: The moving parts: application components, services, interfaces, nodes, system software (active structure + the services/interfaces they expose).

data.description: What the system holds or moves: data objects, artifacts, information (passive structure).

behaviors.description: What happens: processes, functions, events, services (behaviour aspect).

relationships.description: Directed dependencies between named elements, with the BA's reading of intent. Direction matters downstream (server->served, whole->part, realizer->realized).

openQuestions.description: What the diagram does not settle: ambiguous shapes, missing types, contradictions between caption and stencil, orphans. Empty array if none.

name.description: The element's caption / identity, as read from the diagram.

role.description: Plain-language description of what this element is and does in the system.

layer.description: ArchiMate layer the BA proposes for this element.

aspect.description: ArchiMate aspect: active structure, behaviour, passive structure, or motivation.

candidateType.description: The BA's best-guess exact ArchiMate 3.1 type name (e.g. ApplicationComponent, ApplicationInterface, Node, DataObject, BusinessActor). A proposal; the Architect validates it against the semantic layer.

sourceShapeIds.description: Optional: ids of the Visio shapes this element was read from, for traceability.

provenance.description: Optional: where this element came from and how it was read. `source` is the input kind (diagram shape, a requirements/design document, or requirements evidence); `representation` is how it was interpreted (parsed structure, vision over an image, or extracted document text). Fully optional; downstream traceability only. Accepts either the full object or a bare-string shorthand naming only the representation (structure|vision|document); the pipeline normalises the shorthand to {representation: <s>}.

source.description: Input kind the element was read from.

representation.description: How the source was interpreted: deterministic structure, vision over an image, or document text.

from.description: Name of the source element (must match an element name declared above).

to.description: Name of the target element (must match an element name declared above).

type.description: Candidate ArchiMate relationship: Composition, Aggregation, Assignment, Realization, Serving, Access, Influence, Triggering, Flow, Specialization, or Association. The Architect validates legality against the semantic matrix.

intent.description: Plain-language reading of the dependency (e.g. 'the gateway exposes the /v1 interface', 'the agent is served by the gateway').
